title: 851 Michelle dr, Copperas Cove, TX
description:
Welcome to 851 Michelle Dr – A Fresh Start in Copperas Cove!
This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,347 sq ft of stylish living space, perfect for modern comfort and everyday convenience. Step inside to discover brand-new flooring throughout, setting the stage for a warm and inviting interior.

The heart of the home shines with a newly renovated kitchen featuring sleek cabinetry, contemporary finishes, and brand-new appliances—ideal for both casual cooking and entertaining. Both full bathrooms have also been thoughtfully updated with clean, modern touches that bring a spa-like feel.

With its functional layout, fresh upgrades, and move-in ready condition, this home is perfect for a first-time buyer, downsizer, or investor looking for a low-maintenance property. Conveniently located near schools, shopping, and Fort Cavazos, 851 Michelle Dr is ready to welcome its next proud owner.

Schedule your private showing today and fall in love with your next home!
